scripts.build: bun run check:wrangler-configs && bun run check:growth-privacy && bun run check:message-protocol && bun run check:community-feed && bun run --filter @elm-chat/web build && bun run check:security-copy && bun run --filter @elm-chat/api build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @elm-chat/shared typecheck && bun run --filter @elm-chat/crypto typecheck && bun run --filter @elm-chat/web typecheck && bun run --filter @elm-chat/api typecheck
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.deploy: bun run check:wrangler-configs && bun run check:growth-privacy && bun run check:message-protocol && bun run check:community-feed && bun run --filter @elm-chat/web build && bun run check:security-copy && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID="${ELM_CHAT_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID}" wrangler deploy -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: bun run check:wrangler-configs && bun run check:growth-privacy && bun run check:message-protocol && bun run check:community-feed && bun run --filter @elm-chat/web build && bun run check:security-copy && bun run --filter @elm-chat/api deploy
